_comment: Addendum written AFTER the first full evaluation run, which exposed a degenerate pre-registered operating point. The pre-registered rule (configs/analysis_plan.json) is kept and still reported unchanged as 'prereg'. This addendum adds ONE post-hoc operating point; it is labelled post-hoc everywhere it is reported.
finding_that_motivated_it: Pre-registered rule: accept = lowest validation threshold with accepted bad-beat rate <= 5%. The overall bad-beat rate (val 4.3%, test 4.1%) is already below 5%, so the rule is vacuous: t_accept = 0, every beat is 'accepted', the accept/uncertain/reject layer does nothing. The ranking (AURC) is unaffected.

posthoc_operating_point.choice_rationale: 1% is tied to a measured quantity, not tuned: the bad-beat rate on CLEAN images in the tune split is 0.81%, i.e. the digitizer's own floor. 'Accepted' therefore means 'as reliable as a clean render'. Thresholds themselves are still chosen on the validation split only; the test split is used once for reporting.
posthoc_operating_point.disclosure: While deciding, the 2% and 5% targets were also inspected on the VALIDATION split (not on test). Only 1% is reported.
